summary: Execute supported assistant alert answers under an explicit write scope and allow messages to existing agents without a recipient allowlist, preserving assistant identity and audit provenance.

replay.detail: No startup replay or history migration is required. New answer projections retain assistant respondent, owner, session and grant provenance; existing person answers remain readable.

schema.detail: No SQLite schema version, tables, indexes or triggers change. Optional provenance fields are added to new work.person-done claims.

rules.detail: Checkpoint retention rules and their version are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The claim registry digest changes for optional answer provenance. Upgrade replicating members before publishing assistant answers; older registries may retain those claims as unknown until upgraded. Clients must understand SenderRef assistant respondents and write.assistant.answers. Participant and recipient reference types remain narrow.

downtime.detail: The ordinary binary deployment requires a daemon restart; restart duration on a populated fleet has not been measured for this change.

manual.detail: Explicitly add write.assistant.answers to grants that should answer supported owner-assigned structured asks. Read-only grants do not acquire write authority. write.assistant.messages now admits all currently declared agents, irrespective of stored recipient_allowlist metadata; person and nonexistent recipients remain refused.

recovery.detail: Revoke or narrow an assistant grant to stop future writes. Prefer rolling forward all members and clients together; older binaries may retain new provenance-bearing answer claims as unknown and must not be relied upon to enforce the new scope or project assistant attribution.
